billing: Billing and Invoice Policy. Subscription renewals are charged automatically on the first business day of each calendar month using the saved payment method. Late payments incur a fixed fee of fifteen dollars after a grace period of three days. If a credit card declines, notification is sent immediately via email and SMS. Users must update expired cards through the billing portal before the next cycle. Refund requests require submitting an official support ticket within seven days of transaction. Finance team verifies the account activity and issues refunds to the original bank account within four business days. Corporate accounts follow separate invoicing terms negotiated during onboarding. Tax exemptions must be verified with valid documentation uploaded directly to the customer profile.
security: Security and Access Control. Every account must use a strong passphrase containing numbers, uppercase letters, and symbols. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for admin roles and recommended for standard users. If unusual login locations are detected, sessions are terminated immediately. Password resets require clicking the secure token sent to the registered email address. Support agents never ask for credentials over phone or chat. Inactive sessions automatically log out after twenty minutes of inactivity to protect sensitive workspace data.
support: Customer Support Portal Guide. Users can raise tickets for technical assistance anytime through the web dashboard or mobile application. Response times depend on subscription tiers, with enterprise users receiving priority assistance under two hours. Attachments such as error logs and screenshots should be included to expedite troubleshooting. Live chat support operates between 9 AM and 6 PM standard business hours. Phone callbacks can be scheduled via the ticketing menu for complex integration issues.
